description: This script processes performance statistics CSV files from S3 artifacts, extracts relevant data, and uploads it to DynamoDB. It includes functions for retrieving performance stats, generating partition keys, and command-line argument parsing for workflow parameters.

methods.name: get_perf_stats
methods.description: Retrieves performance statistics CSV files from S3 artifacts, extracts data, and returns a list of dictionaries with performance data.

methods.name: generate_partition_key
methods.description: Generates a unique partition key for DynamoDB based on the document's content and repository info.
